args.text: CREATE TABLE An (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK PRIMARY KEY, K LONG, S1 TEXT(255), S2 TEXT(255), S3 TEXT(255), S4 TEXT(255))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UK ON An (K)
CREATE TABLE Src (N LONG CONSTRAINT PKS PRIMARY KEY, K LONG, P TEXT(255))
INSERT INTO An (K, S1, S2, S3, S4) SELECT K, P, P, P, P FROM Src ORDER BY N
SELECT ID, K, S1 FROM An ORDER BY ID
